note: All addresses are FILE offsets, which equal the GBA address minus 0x08000000.

dialogue_font.format: byte0 = advance width, then 15 rows x 2 bytes (16 px wide, MSB = leftmost), 1bpp. The renderer starts at row 4, so the visible band is rows 4..14.

width_table.note: advance px per glyph, read by the engine for BOTH fonts. The engine never takes the width from the glyph itself.

space_advance.note: set by fix_space.mjs; otherwise the word space stays 5px

char_range_check.note: renderer rejects glyph codes > 0xFF; patched from 0x6F to 0xDF so codes 0x80..0xFF are usable

huffman_offsets_ptr.note: uint32 -> huffman tree table; +4 -> tree offsets table

string_table.note: uint32 block data ptr + uint32 lengths ptr per block of 256 strings

free_area.used_by: huffman trees + tree offsets + 42 string blocks + lengths

font_codes.note: ar_codes.json (= translation/font_codes.json) is the single source of truth for letter+form -> code. Codes 0x3C/0x3E/0x5B/0x5D/0x7B/0x7C hold the first six letter forms (freed from the button slots); 0x7F holds jeem-med; 0xDE/0xDF hold the veh forms; 0x40/0x5E hold the guillemets.

control_codes.0x07: makes the box behind the text disappear
control_codes.0x09: font instructions: {09}{02} bold, {09}{04} shaky paragraph, {09}{06} rotate pairs of letters - MUST stay at the string start (ar_build_text.mjs keeps a leading {09}{xx} in front of the RTL reversal)
control_codes.0x0A: shift the text, {10}{nn}? (see instruction table at 0x08039910)
control_codes.0x14: [20] item name, param 1 = specific item, 2 = treasure-chest item
control_codes.0x18: [24] hyphen - only used by this translation as a phrase separator (59 strings)
control_codes.0x19: [25] 's' adder for English plurals - REMOVED from the translation (our font renders it as Latin s)
control_codes.0x1A: [26] button image, param 1-6 = A/B/L/R/Start/Select (drawn from the UI font slots 0x80..0x8A even)
control_codes.0x1D: [29] inventory item with article, param 2-6 - REMOVED from 13 item-name strings (Arabic has no a/an)
control_codes.0x1E: [30] yes/no prompt - MUST be the last control code (620/620 verified)
